scenarios.spec: Implement stable_top_k(items, k). items is a list of dictionaries with string id and integer score. Return at most k ids ordered by descending score. Equal scores preserve original input order exactly. k==0 returns []; k<0 raises ValueError; k greater than the input length returns all items. Do not mutate items.

Implement merge_intervals(intervals). Each interval is [start,end] with integers and start<=end. Raise ValueError for any invalid interval. Sort by start then end and merge intervals that overlap, including sharing an endpoint (for example [1,2] and [2,4] merge). Merely adjacent integer ranges such as [1,2] and [3,4] do not merge. Return new lists and do not mutate the input.

Implement largest_remainder(total, weights). total is a non-negative integer and weights is a list of non-negative integers. Return integer allocations with the same length and exact sum total, proportional by the largest-remainder method. Compute floors exactly, then distribute remaining units by descending fractional remainder; ties go to the lower original index. If total==0 return zeros even when all weights are zero. If total>0 and all weights are zero raise ValueError. Negative inputs raise ValueError. Do not mutate weights.

Implement dedupe_events(events). Each event is a dict with string id, integer seq, and arbitrary JSON-like payload. Keep exactly one event per id: the event with greatest seq; if the same id occurs multiple times with the same greatest seq, keep the last input occurrence. Return new event dictionaries sorted by seq ascending; when selected events have equal seq, preserve the order of their selected input occurrences. Do not mutate events.

Implement apply_edits(text, edits). Each edit is a dict with integer start, integer end, and string replacement. Coordinates refer to the original text and use half-open [start,end). Validate 0<=start<=end<=len(text). Edits may be supplied in any order. They must not overlap; adjacent edits are allowed. Apply all edits simultaneously relative to the original text and return the new string. Raise ValueError for invalid or overlapping edits. Do not mutate edits.

Implement quorum_decision(votes, quorum). votes contains only "yes", "no", or "abstain". quorum must be a positive integer. Participation counts only yes+no; abstentions do not count toward quorum. If participation is below quorum return "no-quorum". Otherwise return "yes" when yes>no, "no" when no>yes, and "tie" when equal. Invalid votes or non-positive quorum raise ValueError. Do not mutate votes.

Implement chunk_windows(items, size, overlap). size must be positive and overlap must satisfy 0<=overlap<size. Windows start every size-overlap elements. Include the final shorter window whenever its start is still inside items. Empty items returns []. Return new lists and do not mutate items.

Implement select_latest(records). Each record is a dict with string key, non-negative integer revision, non-negative integer observed, and arbitrary value. Keep one record per key: greatest revision, then greatest observed, then the last input occurrence if both tie. Return new dictionaries sorted by key lexicographically. Invalid negative revision/observed raises ValueError. Do not mutate records.

Implement normalize_tags(tags). Every item must be a string. Trim leading/trailing whitespace. Reject any item that becomes empty with ValueError. Deduplicate case-insensitively using Unicode casefold, preserving the trimmed spelling of the first occurrence and preserving first-occurrence order. Return a new list. Do not mutate tags.
